skill.name: busco-phylogeny
skill.description: Generate BUSCO and compleasm-based phylogenomics workflows for genome assemblies, including scheduler scripts, ortholog extraction, alignment, trimming, concatenation, and tree inference.
skill.summary: Build reproducible phylogenomics workflows from genome assemblies using BUSCO-style single-copy orthologs.
skill.author: brunoasm

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation, scheduler templates, Conda setup, local workflow file operations, or expected NCBI and phylogenomics tool usage. The main confirmed issue is executable shell command construction with eval in the Aliscore and ALICUT wrappers, which can become command injection with untrusted filenames or option values.

remediation.issue: Shell wrappers execute assembled command strings with eval.
remediation.suggestion: Replace eval with argv-safe command arrays, quote every variable expansion, and pass Aliscore or ALICUT options as validated arrays.

remediation.issue: User-controlled filenames and option values are not consistently validated before use in shell commands.
remediation.suggestion: Reject filenames and option values containing shell metacharacters, newlines, or unexpected paths, and prefer find -print0 or arrays for file lists.

remediation.issue: Bundled third-party Perl tools are included without an integrity record in the marketplace report.
remediation.suggestion: Document upstream source, version, license, and checksums for bundled Aliscore and ALICUT files so users can verify provenance.

content.value_statement: Phylogenomics projects need many linked scripts, inputs, and quality checks. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code generate reproducible BUSCO-style workflows for assemblies, orthologs, alignments, and trees.
actual_capabilities: Guides users through required inputs for genome assembly phylogenomics projects.
Generates SLURM, PBS, local, and cloud-oriented workflow scripts from bundled templates.
Uses bundled helper scripts for NCBI assembly lookup, genome download, renaming, QC, and ortholog extraction.
Supports alignment, trimming, concatenation, partition search, concatenated trees, gene trees, and ASTRAL species trees.
Provides BUSCO lineage, resource planning, quality control, and manuscript methods guidance.
limitations: It does not verify biological correctness of taxon sampling without expert review.
It assumes required external tools are installed or available through the selected environment.
Generated scheduler scripts must be checked against local cluster policies before use.
Some bundled shell wrappers need security hardening before untrusted filenames or options are used.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Phylogenomics Project
use_cases.description: Create a complete analysis plan from local assemblies, NCBI accessions, taxonomic scope, and compute limits.

use_cases.title: Generate Cluster Job Scripts
use_cases.description: Produce scheduler-aware scripts for compleasm, alignment, trimming, IQ-TREE, and ASTRAL steps.

use_cases.title: Document Reproducible Methods
use_cases.description: Summarize workflow choices, tools, parameters, quality thresholds, and citations for a manuscript.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a first BUSCO phylogeny analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a BUSCO-based phylogenomics workflow for my genome assemblies. Ask me for the missing project details first.

prompt_templates.title: Create Scheduler Scripts
prompt_templates.scenario: User knows the cluster type and needs scripts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate SLURM scripts for compleasm, ortholog extraction, alignment, trimming, concatenation, and IQ-TREE. Use 64 total cores and ask for any missing parameters.

prompt_templates.title: Use Mixed Local and NCBI Inputs
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate project with local files and public accessions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a workflow that combines local genome FASTA files with NCBI assembly accessions. Include steps for downloading, renaming, QC, and reproducible directory layout.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Advanced Phylogenomic Inference
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user refining model choice and species-tree strategy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned phylogenomics workflow for a deep taxonomic dataset. Recommend lineage choice, trimming method, IQ-TREE model strategy, bootstrap settings, and ASTRAL gene-tree handling.

output_examples.input: I have 30 insect genomes and a SLURM cluster with 128 cores.
output_examples.output: A staged workflow with project directories, compleasm array jobs, QC reporting, ortholog extraction, MAFFT alignment, trimming choices, IQ-TREE partition search, and job dependency guidance.

output_examples.input: I only have taxon names and need public assemblies.
output_examples.output: A plan to query NCBI assemblies, filter results by quality, save accessions, download genomes, rename samples, and continue with BUSCO-style ortholog discovery.

output_examples.input: I need methods text for my final tree analysis.
output_examples.output: A concise methods draft covering compleasm, ortholog extraction, alignment, trimming, concatenation, IQ-TREE model selection, support metrics, and species-tree inference.

best_practices: Review every generated command before running it on a cluster or shared filesystem.
Keep input genomes, intermediate results, logs, scripts, and final trees in separate directories.
Record tool versions, BUSCO lineage names, model settings, and filtering thresholds for reproducibility.
anti_patterns: Do not run generated scripts on untrusted filenames without reviewing quoting and shell handling.
Do not mix raw inputs, logs, temporary files, and final outputs in one directory.
Do not choose a BUSCO lineage only by name without checking taxonomic scope and expected marker count.

faq.question: Does this skill run the full phylogenomics pipeline for me?
faq.answer: It generates guidance and scripts. Users still need to run tools, check outputs, and adjust settings for their compute environment.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it work with NCBI accessions?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes helper scripts for querying NCBI assemblies and downloading genomes with the NCBI datasets CLI.

faq.question: Does it support SLURM and PBS clusters?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes scheduler templates for SLURM and PBS, plus local execution templates.

faq.question: Can it recommend alignment trimming methods?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes trimAl, ClipKit, BMGE, and Aliscore or ALICUT options for different phylogenomics needs.

faq.question: Is the bundled code safe for untrusted inputs?
faq.answer: Not fully. Some shell wrappers use eval and should be hardened before handling untrusted filenames or option values.
